## UI polish: Pricing and About us

14 fixes across spacing, typography, contrast, layout and states, 2 pages, one stylesheet. Text and brand hue kept.

### Fixes
1. **Spacing**: `.page` `padding: 20px` is off the scale. Now `padding: 24px`. (R-ui-polish-1)
2. **Spacing**: `.page h1` `margin: 0 0 10px` is off the scale. Now `margin: 0 0 12px`. (R-ui-polish-1)
3. **Spacing**: `.go` `padding: 7px 14px` is off the scale. Now `padding: 8px 16px`. (R-ui-polish-1)
4. **Spacing**: about.html inline `margin-top: 9px` on the button is off the scale. Now `margin-top: 8px`. (R-ui-polish-1)
5. **Typography**: `.page h1` `font-size: 26px` is off the scale. Now `font-size: 24px`. (R-ui-polish-2)
6. **Typography**: `.page p` `font-size: 15px` is below the 16 px body minimum. Now `font-size: 16px`. (R-ui-polish-2)
7. **Typography**: `.go` had no font size, so it used the browser default (about 13.33px, off the scale) and did not inherit the page font. Now `font-size: 16px; font-family: inherit`. (R-ui-polish-2)
8. **Typography**: no line-height was set. Now `line-height: 1.25` on `h1` and `line-height: 1.5` on `p`. (R-ui-polish-3)
9. **Typography**: `.page p` had no max-width. Now `max-width: 65ch`. (R-ui-polish-3)
10. **Contrast**: the body text `#9ca3af` on `#ffffff` is only 2.54:1. Now `#6d7787` (same hue), 4.53:1. (R-ui-polish-4)
11. **Layout**: `.go` was about 33 px tall. Now `min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px`. (R-ui-polish-7)
12. **States**: `.go` had no hover style. Now `background: #1d4ed8` on hover, a darker shade of the same blue. (R-ui-polish-6)
13. **States**: `.go` had no focus style. Now `:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: 2px; }`. (R-ui-polish-6)
14. **States**: `.go` had no disabled style. Now `:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }`. (R-ui-polish-6)

| Button label | #ffffff on #2563eb, 5.17:1 | #ffffff on #2563eb, 5.17:1 |

Ratios computed with the contrast script.

### Polished code

#### site.css
```css
.page{padding:24px;font-family:system-ui;background:#ffffff}
.page h1{font-size:24px;line-height:1.25;margin:0 0 12px;color:#111827}
.page p{font-size:16px;line-height:1.5;max-width:65ch;color:#6d7787}
.page .go{background:#2563eb;color:#ffffff;padding:8px 16px;border:none;font-family:inherit;font-size:16px;min-height:44px;min-width:44px;cursor:pointer}
.page .go:hover:not(:disabled){background:#1d4ed8}
.page .go:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #2563eb;outline-offset:2px}
.page .go:disabled{opacity:0.5;cursor:not-allowed}
```
